svg.title: Distances and extinctions of stars towards Orion
svg.desc: Posterior draws and medians of distance and extinction for 92 well-fitted stars within 2.5 kpc towards l = 209.1, b = -19.9. Extinction is low out to about 0.4 kpc and rises, with scatter, to 2 to 5 mag beyond 0.5 kpc, behind the Orion molecular cloud.
